author: jayordan93
quote: classic Bethesda fun, really brings me back to playing their games while growing up.  10/10 would recommend. I am loving the game. I loved the Fallout series, and this game scratches that itch, with better gun-play. Not sure why some man-children are sending kids to down-vote the game. It is fun, and does exactly what I want a video game to do... occupy my time, and keep me entertained. It does exactly that.
